b6_working: (a) euchromatin = loosely packed, active - true. (b) heterochromatin is densely packed and inactive - false. (c) the positively charged histone octamer is wrapped by negatively charged DNA - true. (d) histones are rich in the basic residues lysine and arginine - true. (e) a typical nucleosome contains about 200 bp, not 400 bp - false. Set (a), (c), (d) = option 2.
